SYNTHETIC KEYED TEXT (tests only; written in the style of a published adventure, not from one)

The Saltworks Undercroft
This test level has three keyed areas. A sidebar that numbers things must not read as an area:
1. Do not let the toll-keeper count your coins for you.
2. The salt lies to lanterns.

Exploring This Level
All locations are keyed to the test map.

1. Gatehouse
A squat gatehouse straddles the tunnel. A brass bell hangs from a chain beside the window.
Toll-Keeper. Brannoc Vell, a bald toll-keeper with ink-stained fingers, sits behind the window. He charges 5 sp a head to pass east into area 2 and rings the bell if anyone refuses.
Brannoc wants coin, and he wants the tunnel quiet. If the bell rings, two guards from the barracks arrive in 2 rounds.
Ledger. A successful DC 12 Wisdom (Insight) check reveals that Brannoc pockets half the toll.
2. Needle Hall
A 10-foot-wide hall runs east from the gatehouse (area 1) toward the loft (area 3). Tiny holes pock both walls at knee height.
2a. Pressure Plate
Pressure Plate. A loose flagstone in the middle of the hall is a pressure plate. A character who succeeds on a DC 13 Wisdom (Perception) check notices it.
A creature that steps on the plate triggers a volley of needles: DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 7 (2d6) piercing damage on a failed save.
2b. Broken Needles
Spent needles crunch underfoot here, and a dead rat lies stiff by the east wall.
3. Spider Loft
Rubble fills the west half of this loft, and torn webbing sags from the beams.
Giant Centipedes. Three giant centipedes nest in the rubble. They attack all who enter.
Treasure. A dead prospector under the rubble still wears a pouch holding 12 gp.

Chapter Two: The Brine Vaults
1. Flooded Stair
This area belongs to the next level and must never be read as level one's.
